prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in post-adoption or post-certificate sequence was helpful (underpredicted in round 1 at +13.3% vs +12.0%), and account sync banners were helpful (+2.7%), but moving sign-in after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%) and hand-off timing showed no clear effect.
Path clarity headline updates were helpful and underpredicted (+5.9% vs +1.0%), whereas general path copy simplification, value proposition refreshes, and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%) and background hatching readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted) were helpful, though interactive waiting room impact was overpredicted (+8.0% vs +5.6%); 3D progress trackers showed no clear effect.
Photo quality guides and companion previews were helpful (+7.6%, overpredicted at +10.0%), while compact friend selection grid layouts made results worse (-7.7%) and split photo upload assistants showed no clear effect.
System tray location notification tips were helpful (+3.8%), but first interaction notification tips made results worse (-6.5%), and sound notifications, spawn alerts, and mascot welcome stages showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: +7.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: -7.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +2.1% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +3.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.2% over 2 test(s)
- home, redesign: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.5% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.3% over 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 28.0%

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Generation Fallback Assistant Flow: Adds an interactive fallback tip carousel during photo upload offering preset templates if custom pet generation fails or looks wrong. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or producing incorrect visual results during adoption.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Verification Hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging in restores all existing pets and progress. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Readiness Progress Details: Displays active progress indicators and loading stage status text while waiting for the mascot to render on the desktop. (why: Home step has a 201s median / 2336s mean time, and 3 support tickets complained that pets failed to show up on the desktop.)
3: [home, notification] Background Hatching Notification Status Alert: Shows a system notification readiness badge on the waiting screen letting users know they can safely minimize the app. (why: Median wait time on the home step is 201 seconds, causing users to get impatient or drop out while waiting.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Clear Outcome Headline: Updates the choose_path headline and body to explicitly differentiate adopting a ready-made pet versus creating a custom pet. (why: Headline updates on choose_path previously improved conversion by +5.9%, and choose_path currently drops 21% of users.)
5: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Desktop Mascot Interaction Badge: Adds an animated highlight badge on the home intro screen directing users to immediate system tray desktop controls. (why: Finish step conversion is 70.1% and multiple users wrote support about being confused on how to control their pet after setup.)

scores.note: Target step has the largest funnel drop (37%); photo guides work but new assistant flow requires full release.
Solves #1 support complaint with simple text hint; sign_in drop is already low.
Addresses long render wait times (201s median) where readiness indicators historically perform well.
Low cost change for long wait step, but home notification tests historically show modest lift (+0.2%).
Target step drops 21% and path clarity headline updates previously yielded strong +5.9% lift.
Addresses 30% drop on finish step with support evidence, though mascot/interaction badges show mixed past results.
